books.title: Rory and the Rainbow
books.coverAlt: Rory the rabbit cheers on a green hill under a big rainbow

pages.text: Rain taps on the roof. Rory the rabbit looks up.
pages.alt: Rain falls on a little house with a red roof. Rory the rabbit stands in a puddle and looks up.

pages.text: The rain stops. Look, a rainbow!
pages.alt: The rain has stopped. A big rainbow shines over the hills, and Rory points up at it.

pages.text: Rory runs down the road to reach it.
pages.alt: Rory runs down a winding road toward the rainbow far away.

pages.text: The road ends at a rushing river.
pages.alt: The road stops at a wide, rushing river. Rory stands at the edge and says whoa.

pages.text: Rory ties reeds into a raft.
pages.alt: By the river, Rory ties a bundle of tall reeds with rope. A raft made of reeds lies on the grass.

pages.text: He rows the raft on the river.
pages.alt: Rory sits on his reed raft and rows across the river with a wooden paddle.

pages.text: Remy the raccoon waves. "Room on the raft?"
pages.alt: Remy the raccoon stands on a rock in the river and waves. Rory, on the raft, holds out a paw to welcome him.

pages.text: Then they see a robot, stuck in the mud.
pages.alt: From the raft, Rory and Remy see a blue robot stuck up to its middle in brown mud, waving its arms for help.

pages.text: Rory and Remy pull him out with a red ribbon.
pages.alt: Rory and Remy lean back and pull a long red ribbon. The robot pops out of the mud with a happy face.

pages.text: "Thank you! Ride in my rocket!" says the robot.
pages.alt: The happy robot points to its red and white rocket. Rory and Remy cheer.

pages.text: They land by the rainbow, in a field of roses.
pages.alt: The rocket has landed in a field of red and pink roses, right where the rainbow touches the ground. Rory, Remy and the robot smile.

pages.text: Rory, Remy, and the robot run and play!
pages.alt: Under the rainbow, Rory jumps for a red ball, Remy runs and the robot hops, with confetti everywhere.

books.title: Rosie and the Red Wagon
books.coverAlt: Rosie pulls her shiny red wagon along a sunny country road; the grey rabbit and the raccoon sit happily in the wagon waving.

pages.text: Rosie has a red wagon.
pages.alt: Rosie stands proudly beside her shiny red wagon on a sunny road, smiling.

pages.text: She ties a rope on it.
pages.alt: Rosie kneels and ties a tan rope onto the red wagon's handle.

pages.text: Rosie rolls the wagon up a hill.
pages.alt: Rosie pulls the red wagon up a gentle green hill, rolling along.

pages.text: A rabbit sits by the road.
pages.alt: A small grey rabbit sits beside the road, watching Rosie and her red wagon come by.

pages.text: "Can I ride?" asks the rabbit.
pages.alt: The grey rabbit looks up at Rosie hopefully, one paw raised as if asking for a ride, next to the red wagon.

pages.text: "Yes! Hop in!" says Rosie.
pages.alt: Rosie laughs and points into the wagon; the grey rabbit hops into the red wagon.

pages.text: Then a raccoon waves.
pages.alt: A raccoon by the roadside waves hello at Rosie, who pulls the red wagon with the grey rabbit inside.

pages.text: The raccoon rides in the wagon, too.
pages.alt: The raccoon and the grey rabbit ride together in the red wagon while Rosie pulls it.

pages.text: Rain falls on them all.
pages.alt: Rain starts falling on Rosie, the rabbit and the raccoon on the road; raindrops everywhere, grey clouds.

pages.text: Rosie holds a big leaf up on top.
pages.alt: Rosie holds a giant green leaf up over the wagon like an umbrella, the rabbit and raccoon dry underneath in the rain.

pages.text: The rain stops. The sun comes out.
pages.alt: The rain stops and the sun comes out from behind clouds; Rosie, the rabbit and the raccoon look up smiling.

pages.text: Rosie, the rabbit and the raccoon wave. What a ride!
pages.alt: Rosie, the grey rabbit and the raccoon wave happily together beside the red wagon on a sunny hilltop.

books.title: Ray and the Lost Ring
books.coverAlt: Ray the robin holds up a shiny gold ring with a blue gem in his beak, smiling, by a little river with reeds and a red-roofed cottage behind.

pages.text: Ray the robin has a ring.
pages.alt: Ray the robin sits on a branch admiring a shiny gold ring with a blue gem.

pages.text: It is a shiny ring.
pages.alt: Close up of the shiny gold ring with a blue gem sparkling in the sun, Ray the robin smiling at it.

pages.text: One day, the ring is gone!
pages.alt: Ray the robin looks shocked at an empty branch: the ring is gone.

pages.text: Ray looks by the river.
pages.alt: Ray the robin searches along the bank of a little blue river.

pages.text: Ray looks on the roof.
pages.alt: Ray the robin searches on top of a red roof of a cottage.

pages.text: Ray looks in the reeds.
pages.alt: Ray the robin peeks between tall green reeds by the water.

pages.text: A red ladybug says, "Look up high!"
pages.alt: A tiny red ladybug on a leaf points one leg upward, talking to Ray the robin.

pages.text: Ray sees a raccoon on a log.
pages.alt: Ray the robin spots a raccoon sitting on a fallen log.

pages.text: The raccoon has the ring!
pages.alt: The raccoon on the log holds up the shiny gold ring with a blue gem.

pages.text: "Is this ring lost?" asks the raccoon.
pages.alt: The raccoon holds out the ring toward Ray the robin with a kind, questioning face.

pages.text: "Yes! Thank you!" sings Ray.
pages.alt: Ray the robin sings happily with his beak open, the ring back with him, little music notes shapes around him.

pages.text: Ray gives the raccoon a ribbon to say thank you.
pages.alt: Ray the robin gives the raccoon a red ribbon as a gift, both smiling.

books.title: Boo the Bat on Halloween
books.coverAlt: Boo the purple bat flies under a big glowing moon holding an orange candy bucket, happy pumpkins below in a cozy village.

pages.text: Boo the bat wakes up at night.
pages.alt: Boo the bat hangs upside down from a branch and opens his eyes, waking up under a starry night sky.

pages.text: It is Halloween! Boo gets his bucket.
pages.alt: Boo the bat holds up a small orange candy bucket, excited, happy pumpkins glowing nearby.

pages.text: Boo puts on a big hat.
pages.alt: Boo the bat wears a big tall purple witch hat, smiling proudly.

pages.text: Boo flies past the moon.
pages.alt: Boo the bat flies across a big glowing full moon.

pages.text: Boo sees a pumpkin with a happy face.
pages.alt: Boo the bat looks at a carved pumpkin with a big happy face glowing on a doorstep.

pages.text: A cat in a cape waves at Boo.
pages.alt: A small black kitten in a red cape waves at Boo the bat on a village path.

pages.text: "Trick or treat!" says Boo.
pages.alt: Boo the bat at a front door with his orange candy bucket held out, cheerful.

pages.text: A candy drops in his bucket.
pages.alt: A wrapped candy drops into Boo's orange bucket, Boo smiling.

pages.text: Then a little ghost says, "Boo!"
pages.alt: A small round smiling white ghost pops out from behind a pumpkin and surprises Boo the bat.

pages.text: Boo jumps. Then he laughs.
pages.alt: Boo the bat jumps in surprise, then laughs with the little ghost.

pages.text: Boo and the ghost share the candy.
pages.alt: Boo the bat and the little ghost sit together sharing candy from the bucket.

pages.text: Boo goes to bed. Happy Halloween!
pages.alt: Boo the bat tucked into a tiny cozy bed under a window with the moon outside, sleepy and happy.

books.title: Rory the Rabbit on Halloween
books.coverAlt: Rory the rabbit in a silver robot costume holds up an orange candy bucket with a red ribbon bow, beside the real robot dressed as a rocket, under a big glowing moon with happy pumpkins along the road and a little red-roofed cottage on a hill.

pages.text: Rory the rabbit wakes up. It is Halloween!
pages.alt: Rory the rabbit sits up in his cozy bed and stretches, the morning sun rising over the hills in the window behind him and a little pumpkin on the sill.

pages.text: Rory puts on his robot costume.
pages.alt: Rory stands in his room in a silver cardboard-box robot costume with two buttons and an antenna headband, arms out stiff like a robot, a golden evening sky in the window.

pages.text: He gets a bucket with a red ribbon.
pages.alt: At his own front door at sunset, Rory holds up a small orange candy bucket with a big shiny red ribbon bow tied on its handle.

pages.text: Rory runs down the road. The moon is round.
pages.alt: Rory runs along a winding road lined with glowing happy pumpkins, a big round moon in the night sky.

pages.text: The real robot comes too. He is a rocket!
pages.alt: The friendly blue robot wears a white rocket costume with a red cone hat and points his arms up, while Rory, dressed as a robot, laughs beside him.

pages.text: Rory sees a house with a red roof.
pages.alt: A big pointed red roof fills the top of the picture with the moon on its peak, over a little round lilac cottage with glowing windows, and Rory and the robot look up at it.

pages.text: Ring, ring! "Happy Halloween!" says Rory.
pages.alt: Rory pulls the rope of a shiny brass bell by the lilac cottage's round green front door, holding out his bucket.

pages.text: Plop! Raisins land in his bucket. Yum!
pages.alt: A kind old hedgehog tips a box of raisins into Rory's orange bucket, and Rory smiles.

pages.text: Rory rests on a rock. A ghost says, "Boo!"
pages.alt: Rory sits on a big round grey rock with his bucket beside him as a small friendly sheet ghost peeks over the back of the rock, and his ears shoot up in surprise.

pages.text: Rory jumps. The ghost is Remy the raccoon!
pages.alt: The sheet slides off to show Remy the raccoon grinning, while Rory jumps and laughs.

pages.text: They laugh. Rory gives Remy half his raisins.
pages.alt: Rory and Remy sit on the rock laughing, and Rory pours raisins from his bucket into Remy's paws.

pages.text: Rory the rabbit goes to bed. Happy Halloween!
pages.alt: Rory is tucked into his cozy bed with sleepy eyes, his robot costume and bucket on the floor, the moon in the window.

books.title: Sid the Seagull on Halloween
books.coverAlt: Sid the seagull in his orange pumpkin suit, sailor cap and sailor collar flies under a big glowing moon over the sea, a purple candy sack hanging from his foot, happy pumpkins glowing on the beach below.

pages.text: The sun goes down by the sea.
pages.alt: A big orange sun sinks into the calm sea while Sid the seagull, in his sailor cap and collar, watches from a wooden post beside two glowing happy pumpkins.

pages.text: It is Halloween! Sid has a sack for candy.
pages.alt: Sid the seagull, in his sailor cap and collar, holds up a bright purple candy sack in one wing, excited, as the moon rises and happy pumpkins glow on the sand.

pages.text: Sid wears a silly pumpkin suit.
pages.alt: Sid the seagull shows off his round orange pumpkin suit on the moonlit sand, wings out and one foot up in a silly pose.

pages.text: Sid flies by the big round moon.
pages.alt: Sid the seagull in his pumpkin suit flies across a big glowing full moon, his purple sack hanging from one foot.

pages.text: Seven happy pumpkins sit on a wall.
pages.alt: Seven glowing carved pumpkins with happy faces sit in a row on a low stone wall, and Sid waves at them from the end of the wall.

pages.text: Sadie waves at Sid. She is a little witch!
pages.alt: Sadie, dressed up in a tall purple witch hat and cape with a little toy broom, waves at Sid on a lantern-lit village path.

pages.text: "Trick or treat!" say Sid and Sadie.
pages.alt: Sid holds his purple sack wide open at a cottage door with a glowing pumpkin, Sadie in her witch costume smiling beside him.

pages.text: Candy falls into Sid's sack.
pages.alt: A kind grandma at the door tips wrapped candies from her orange bowl into Sid's open purple sack, and Sid smiles widely.

pages.text: Then a seal in a sheet says, "Boo!"
pages.alt: A seal wearing a white sheet with eye holes pops up beside a glowing pumpkin, flippers and whiskers peeking out, and Sid and Sadie lean back in surprise.

pages.text: It is Sam! Sid and Sam giggle and giggle.
pages.alt: The sheet slips off to show Sam the seal laughing, and Sid laughs with him, holding his tummy, while Sadie giggles behind them.

pages.text: They sit on the sand and share the candy.
pages.alt: Sid, Sadie and Sam sit together on the moonlit golden sand by the sea, sharing candy from Sid's purple sack.

pages.text: Sid goes to bed by the sea. Happy Halloween!
pages.alt: Sid the seagull, in his sailor cap and collar, is tucked into a small round bed in a cozy beach hut, his pumpkin suit on a hook, the moon shining over the sea through a round window.

books.title: Leon's Trick-or-Treat Night
books.coverAlt: Leon the lion cub in a ladybug costume holds up his glowing lantern and a purple candy bucket by the moonlit lake, Lucky the puppy beside him dressed as a lemon.

pages.text: Leon the lion wakes up from his nap.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub sits up in his small bed with a big happy yawn after his nap, the full moon shining through a round window.

pages.text: It is trick-or-treat night! Leon gets his lantern.
pages.alt: Inside his cozy cottage, Leon the lion cub holds up his glowing lantern, his empty purple candy bucket at his feet and happy pumpkins glowing through the window.

pages.text: Leon puts on a ladybug costume.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub proudly shows off his red ladybug costume with big black spots and an antennae headband in his mane.

pages.text: Lucky the puppy is a lemon!
pages.alt: Lucky the white puppy trots in wearing a round yellow lemon suit while Leon in his ladybug costume laughs.

pages.text: They walk by the lake under the moon.
pages.alt: Leon and Lucky walk along the shore of a calm lake with the big full moon shining on the water.

pages.text: A happy pumpkin sits on a big log.
pages.alt: A small carved pumpkin with a happy face glows on top of a big fallen log as Leon and Lucky smile at it.

pages.text: "Trick or treat!" says Leon.
pages.alt: Leon in his ladybug costume calls out cheerfully at a cottage door, holding out his purple bucket and his glowing lantern.

pages.text: A kind lady drops candy in his bucket.
pages.alt: A kind smiling lady at the door tips colorful wrapped candies from her orange bowl into Leon's purple bucket.

pages.text: Then a ghost jumps out of the leaves. "Boo!"
pages.alt: A small figure in a white sheet, with happy eyes, floppy ears and black hooves peeking out, jumps out of a pile of autumn leaves as Leon and Lucky lean back in surprise.

pages.text: It is Libby the lamb! Leon laughs.
pages.alt: The sheet slips back to show Libby the lamb laughing, and Leon laughs with her while Lucky wags his tail.

pages.text: They sit by the lantern and share the candy.
pages.alt: Leon, Lucky and Libby sit in a circle around the glowing lantern by the lake, sharing candy from the purple bucket.

pages.text: Leon goes to bed. Good night, Leon!
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub is tucked into his cozy bed, smiling sleepily, with Lucky curled at his feet and the lantern glowing softly.

books.title: Zoe the Zebra on Halloween
books.coverAlt: Zoe the zebra in a silly green zucchini suit cheers on the zoo path with her orange candy bucket, under a big glowing moon, with lanterns on the zoo arch and happy pumpkins along the path.

pages.text: Zoe the zebra woke up from her nap.
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra sits up on her straw bed and stretches as she wakes from her nap, the moon rising in the evening sky outside her round window.

pages.text: It's Halloween at the zoo! Zoe got her bucket.
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra stands in her open front door holding up a small orange candy bucket, looking out at the zoo arch hung with glowing lanterns and happy pumpkins along the path.

pages.text: Zoe put on a zucchini suit. How silly!
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra strikes a silly pose in a puffy green zucchini suit with a hood and a brown stem on top, the front still open.

pages.text: Zoe pulled the zipper up. Zip!
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra pulls the yellow zipper pull up the front of her zucchini suit.

pages.text: Zoe zoomed out under the big round moon.
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra runs fast along the zoo path under a big full moon, her candy bucket swinging.

pages.text: Zack the zookeeper held a glowing pumpkin.
pages.alt: Zack the zookeeper stands in the open doorway of his hut holding up a glowing pumpkin with a happy face, while Zoe looks up at it from the path.

pages.text: "Trick or treat!" said Zoe.
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra holds out her orange bucket below Zack's open green door and calls out cheerfully, a glowing pumpkin on the step beside her.

pages.text: Zack put some candy in her bucket.
pages.alt: Zack the zookeeper bends down and drops a few wrapped candies into Zoe's orange bucket, and Zoe smiles.

pages.text: Then a little ghost said, "Boo!" Zoe jumped!
pages.alt: A small ghost with striped arms and legs poking out from under its sheet pops out from behind a pumpkin, and Zoe jumps in surprise.

pages.text: Zoe laughed. "It's a little zebra in a sheet!"
pages.alt: The sheet slips back to show a giggling baby zebra, and Zoe laughs with it.

pages.text: Zoe and the little zebra shared the candy.
pages.alt: Zoe and the little zebra sit on the grass under the moon, sharing candy from the orange bucket.

pages.text: Zoe the zebra went to bed. Happy Halloween!
pages.alt: Zoe the zebra is tucked into her straw bed under a lavender blanket, her zucchini suit on a hook and the moon in the window.

books.title: Finn the Fish on Halloween
books.coverAlt: Finn the orange fish in lilac fairy wings leaps out of the moonlit sea with his funny-face candy bucket, happy pumpkins glowing on the shore.

pages.text: Finn the fish wakes up at night.
pages.alt: Finn the orange fish wakes up beside his big grey rock under the moonlit sea, a few sleepy bubbles rising.

pages.text: It is Halloween! Finn puts on fairy wings.
pages.alt: Finn the fish shows off his see-through lilac fairy wings and tiny star crown under the sea.

pages.text: Finn gets a bucket with a funny face.
pages.alt: Finn holds up his orange candy bucket, which has a funny face with googly eyes and its tongue poking out.

pages.text: Finn waves a fin at the big moon.
pages.alt: Finn pokes his head out of the sea and waves a fin at a big glowing full moon.

pages.text: Five happy pumpkins glow by the sea.
pages.alt: Five happy carved pumpkins glow in a row on the shore while Finn peeks out of the water.

pages.text: The duck family swims by, dressed as bats!
pages.alt: A mother duck and three yellow ducklings swim past wearing bat ears and bat wings, and Finn grins at them.

pages.text: Finn calls to a gull, "Trick or treat!"
pages.alt: By the little dock, Finn holds up his bucket and calls out to a smiling seagull standing on a post, a bowl of fudge at its foot.

pages.text: The gull drops fudge in Finn's bucket.
pages.alt: The seagull drops two squares of chocolate fudge into Finn's orange bucket.

pages.text: Then a ghost with a furry tail says, "Boo!"
pages.alt: A ghost in a white sheet with a furry orange fox tail poking out says boo on the shore, and Finn looks surprised.

pages.text: Finn jumps! It is Fay the fox.
pages.alt: The sheet slips off and it is Fay the fox laughing, while Finn jumps out of the water with a splash.

pages.text: Finn and Fay share the fudge.
pages.alt: Fay the fox sits on the dock with Finn beside her in the water, each holding up a square of fudge.

pages.text: Finn falls asleep by his rock. Happy Halloween!
pages.alt: Finn sleeps snuggled in green kelp by his rock, his fairy wings and candy bucket resting beside him.

pages.text: Penny the penguin has a pink pail.
Penny waddles down to the pond.
Penny finds a pebble. Then another pebble!
Penny puts the pebbles in the pail.
Pat the pig peeks in. "Can I paint them?"
Penny and Pat paint the pebbles.
Pink pebbles! Peach pebbles!
Polly the parrot lands on a pole.
"Polly! Come to our party!" says Penny.
Polly brings a pie to the party.
They put the pebbles in a row by the pond.
Penny, Pat, and Polly have a pebble party!
Bo the bear has a big boat.
Bo puts a basket in the boat.
In the basket: berries, buns, and a banana.
Bo rows the boat to the beach.
A bee buzzes by. Buzz, buzz!
"Can I come?" asks Bella the bee.
Bo and Bella sit on the beach.
A ball bounces by the boat.
Ben the bunny wants the ball back.
Bo bumps the ball to Ben.
Ben and Bella and Bo eat berries and buns.
What a fun day at the beach, Bo!
Mia the mouse wants to make muffins.
Mia gets milk and a mixing bowl.
Mia mixes and mixes. What a mess!
Max the mole peeks in. "More milk?"
Max adds melon. Mia adds maple syrup.
Mia puts the muffins in the oven.
The moon rises over the meadow.
The muffins are ready at last!
Max and Mia munch muffins.
"Mia, may I take one to Molly?" asks Max.
Molly the moose says, "Many thanks!"
Mia, Max, and Molly share a meal under the moon.
Nora the newt has a nice, neat nest.
Nora takes a nap.
Knock, knock! A noise wakes Nora.
It is Ned the newt. "My net is lost!"
Nora looks near the nest.
Ned looks by the old log.
"No net here," says Ned.
Nora spots a net up a tree.
Nora nudges it with her nose.
The net drops. "Neat!" says Ned.
Night falls. Nora makes noodles.
Ned eats noodles with Nora. What a nice night!
Toby the tiger has a tiny tuba.
Toby taps his toes.
"Too, too, too!" goes the tuba.
Tia the toucan comes by.
Tia likes the tune. She taps along.
Toby and Tia play for the town.
Ten turkeys come to hear.
The turkeys tap their toes too.
A tiny toad jumps on the tuba.
The toad sings a tune.
Everyone claps. Toby takes a bow.
"Time for tea!" says Toby.
Dot the duck wants a pool to dive in.
Dot digs a hole. Dig, dig, dig!
Dan the dog comes to help.
Dan digs too. Dust flies!
The hole gets deep.
Down comes the rain.
The rain fills the hole all day.
Now Dot has a deep pool!
Dot dips her toes.
"Dan, let's dive!" says Dot.
Dot dives. Dan dives. Splash!
Dot is a happy duck. Dan is a happy dog!
Kip the kangaroo has a kite.
The kite has a long tail.
Kip hops up the hill.
Whoosh! The wind catches the kite.
Up, up, up goes Kip's kite!
Cody the cow comes to see.
"Can I hold it?" says Cody.
Cody holds the kite. The wind gets strong!
The kite carries Cody up in the air!
"Come down, Cody!" calls Kip.
Cody comes down in the corn.
Kip gives Cody a carrot. What a day!
Goldie the goose gets a gift.
The gift is a guitar!
Goldie goes to the garden.
Goldie plays a happy tune.
Gus the goat comes to the gate.
"Goldie, can I have a go?" asks Gus.
Gus gets the guitar.
Gus is no good at it!
Goldie shows Gus how.
Gus gets better and better.
The garden gophers come to hear.
Goldie and Gus give a garden show!
Finn the fish lives by a big rock.
Finn has fast fins.
One day, Finn finds a feather.
"Whose feather?" asks Finn.
Finn swims far and fast.
Finn meets Fay the fox by the shore.
"Not my feather," says Fay.
Finn meets a family of ducks.
"Not our feather," they say.
Then a gull swoops down. It has no tail feather!
Finn gives the feather back. "Thank you!" says the gull.
Finn feels fine. What a fun day!
Val the van is in a valley.
Val goes to the village.
"Beep, beep!" goes Val.
Val takes a vase to Vicky.
Vicky puts a violet in the vase.
Val takes vegetables to the vet.
The vet shares them with the animals.
Val takes a violin to Vince.
Vince plays a very sweet tune.
The village comes to hear.
Vicky washes Val. Val looks very shiny.
"Thank you, Val!" says the village.
Sid the seagull lives by the sea.
The sun is up. The sand is warm.
Sid sees a sandwich on a seat.
"Sadie, may I have some?" says Sid.
Sadie gives Sid a bite.
"Thank you, Sadie!" Sid sings a song.
Sadie and Sid sit in the sand.
They dig a big sand hill.
Sid adds a seashell on top.
Oh no! The sea rolls in.
The sand hill is gone. Sid is sad.
"Silly Sid! We can make one more!" says Sadie.

books.title: Sam's Sailboat
books.coverAlt: Sam the seal sits in his little wooden sailboat with a white sail on a calm sunny blue sea, smiling.

pages.text: Sam the seal has a sailboat.
pages.alt: Sam the seal stands proudly next to his little wooden sailboat at the shore.

pages.text: The sun is up. Sam sails out.
pages.alt: Sam the seal sails out in his sailboat under a bright rising sun.

pages.text: The sea is calm and blue.
pages.alt: A wide calm blue sea, Sam's small sailboat far away on it.

pages.text: Sam sees a little fish.
pages.alt: Sam the seal leans over the side of his sailboat looking at a little orange fish in the water.

pages.text: The fish is sad. "I can't find my home!"
pages.alt: The little orange fish looks sad and lost in the water near the boat.

pages.text: "Sit in my boat," says Sam.
pages.alt: Sam the seal holds out a flipper inviting the little fish; the fish sits in a bucket of water in the boat.

pages.text: They sail by a seagull.
pages.alt: Sam's sailboat with the little fish passes a white seagull flying low.

pages.text: The seagull says, "Go that way!"
pages.alt: The seagull points one wing toward the horizon, talking to Sam.

pages.text: Sam sails and sails.
pages.alt: Sam's sailboat glides across the sea, sail full of wind.

pages.text: Soon, they see a big reef.
pages.alt: Ahead, a colourful coral reef shows under clear water; Sam and the little fish look at it.

pages.text: The mom fish is there! She is so happy.
pages.alt: The mom fish swims up to the little fish, both happy, by the reef, Sam watching.

pages.text: Sam sings a song all the way home.
pages.alt: Sam the seal sings in his sailboat sailing home at sunset.

books.title: Sophie's Silly Soup
books.coverAlt: Sophie stirs a big blue pot of soup with a wooden spoon, laughing, a striped sock poking out of the pot.

pages.text: Sophie is making soup.
pages.alt: Sophie in her apron stirs a big blue pot of soup on the stove.

pages.text: Sophie adds a carrot.
pages.alt: Sophie drops an orange carrot into the pot.

pages.text: Sophie adds a big potato.
pages.alt: Sophie drops a big brown potato into the pot.

pages.text: Then Sophie adds a sock!
pages.alt: Sophie drops a red-and-white striped sock into the pot, giggling.

pages.text: "Oh no, a sock in the soup is silly!"
pages.alt: Sophie covers her mouth laughing, pointing at the sock floating in the soup.

pages.text: Sophie pulls the sock out.
pages.alt: Sophie pulls the dripping striped sock out of the pot with tongs.

pages.text: She adds salt.
pages.alt: Sophie sprinkles salt from a little shaker into the pot.

pages.text: She adds some seeds.
pages.alt: Sophie sprinkles a handful of little seeds into the pot.

pages.text: Sophie gives the soup a sip.
pages.alt: Sophie takes a sip of soup from a wooden spoon.

pages.text: "Yummy soup!" says Sophie.
pages.alt: Sophie rubs her tummy with a delighted face, spoon in hand.

pages.text: Sophie calls her pals to the table.
pages.alt: Sophie waves to the teddy-bear and duck pals, calling them to the wooden table.

pages.text: They sit and sip the soup together.
pages.alt: Sophie and the bear and duck pals sit at the table sipping bowls of soup together.

pages.text: Zoe the zebra woke up at the zoo.
It felt cold. Zoe got her coat.
Zoe pulled the zipper. Zip!
Oh no! The zipper got stuck.
Zoe called Zack the zookeeper.
Zack tugged the zipper. Zip, zip!
Zap! The zipper went up.
"Thank you, Zack!" said Zoe.
Zoe zoomed out to play.
Zoom, zoom, all around the zoo!
Zack gave Zoe a zucchini for lunch.
Zoe the zebra felt warm and happy.
Shay the shark is shy.
Shay hides in the shadow of a ship.
"Come and see the show!" shout the crabs.
Shay shakes her head.
Shimmer the seahorse swims by.
"Shay, come with me to the show!" says Shimmer.
Shay is not sure.
Shimmer shows Shay a shiny shell.
"Shake it in the show!" says Shimmer.
Shay shakes the shell. Shh, shh, shh!
The crabs cheer. "Shay, you are a star!"
Shay is not shy now. She shines!

books.title: Shane and the Shiny Shell
books.coverAlt: Shane holds up a big shiny spiral shell on a sunny beach, a little red crab peeking out of it.

pages.text: Shane is at the sea.
pages.alt: Shane stands on a sunny beach by the sea, happy.

pages.text: He sees a shiny shell.
pages.alt: Shane spots a shiny pink spiral shell in the sand.

pages.text: Shane picks up the shell.
pages.alt: Shane picks up the shiny shell.

pages.text: He shows it to his mom.
pages.alt: Shane shows the shell to his mom on the beach.

pages.text: "Shake it!" she says.
pages.alt: Mom smiles and makes a shaking motion with her hands, talking to Shane.

pages.text: Shane shakes the shell. A crab comes out!
pages.alt: Shane shakes the shell and a little red crab pops out.

pages.text: The crab is shy.
pages.alt: The little red crab hides its face shyly behind its claws.

pages.text: Shane sits very still.
pages.alt: Shane sits very still in the sand, watching quietly.

pages.text: The crab peeks out of the shell.
pages.alt: The crab peeks out of the shell.

pages.text: Shane shares a snack with the crab.
pages.alt: Shane offers the crab a little cracker snack.

pages.text: The crab is not shy now.
pages.alt: The crab waves its claw at Shane, no longer shy.

pages.text: Shane and the crab are pals. Shane shouts, "Yay!"
pages.alt: Shane cheers with arms up, the crab beside him, both happy.

books.title: Shawn and His Shadow
books.coverAlt: Shawn waves at his own big shadow on a sunny cream wall; the shadow waves back.

pages.text: Shawn has a shadow.
pages.alt: Shawn stands in a sunny yard with his shadow stretching beside him.

pages.text: The shadow is on the wall.
pages.alt: Shawn's shadow is cast clearly on a cream wall next to him.

pages.text: Shawn waves. The shadow waves.
pages.alt: Shawn waves, and his shadow on the wall waves too.

pages.text: Shawn hops. The shadow hops.
pages.alt: Shawn hops, and his shadow on the wall hops too.

pages.text: Shawn shakes. The shadow shakes.
pages.alt: Shawn wiggles and shakes, his shadow shaking on the wall.

pages.text: Then the sun goes down. Where is the shadow?
pages.alt: Evening: the sun is setting and Shawn looks for his shadow, which is fading.

pages.text: Shawn is sad. The shadow is gone.
pages.alt: Shawn looks sad in the dim evening; no shadow on the wall.

pages.text: Mom shines a lamp.
pages.alt: Indoors, Mom switches on a lamp, light shining across the room.

pages.text: The shadow is back! Shawn cheers.
pages.alt: Shawn's shadow is back on the bedroom wall; Shawn cheers.

pages.text: Shawn makes a shadow dog with his hands.
pages.alt: Shawn makes a dog shape with his hands, a shadow dog on the wall.

pages.text: The shadow dog shakes its tail.
pages.alt: The shadow dog on the wall wags its tail.

pages.text: Shawn and his shadow go to bed.
pages.alt: Shawn climbs into bed, his shadow beside him on the wall.

pages.text: Chip the chipmunk has chubby cheeks.
Chip chews on chestnuts.
It is chilly. Chip needs a cozy spot.
Chip checks the old chimney.
A chick is in the chimney!
"Cheep, cheep!" says the chick.
The chick is chilly too.
Chip shares his chestnuts.
Chip and the chick chat and chew.
They find a comfy chair.
Chip and the chick cuddle up in the chair.
"Cheers for a new pal!" chirps the chick.
Jax the jaguar lives in the jungle.
Jax likes to jump and jog.
One day, Jax finds a jar of jam.
"Yum, jam!" Jax jumps for joy.
Jax cannot get the lid off the jar.
Along comes Jill the giraffe.
Jill gives the jar a twist.
Pop! The jar is open.
"Join me for jam!" says Jax.
Jax and Jill eat jam and drink juice.
Jill tells a joke. Jax giggles.
What a jolly day in the jungle!
Leo the lamb likes to leap.
Leo leaps by the lake.
A leaf lands on Leo's head.
"A lucky leaf!" Leo laughs.
Leo takes the leaf to Lucy.
Lucy is a lazy lizard on a log.
"Look, Lucy! A lucky leaf!" says Leo.
Lucy licks her lips. "Is it lunch?"
"No, Lucy! Let's make a leaf boat!"
They lay the leaf on the lake.
A ladybug rides the leaf boat.
Leo and Lucy wave. What luck!

books.title: Libby and the Lemon
books.coverAlt: Libby the white lamb holds a yellow lemon in a sunny garden, a little ladybug on her head.

pages.text: Libby the lamb is hungry.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb holds her tummy, looking hungry, in a sunny garden.

pages.text: Libby wants lunch.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb looks around the garden for lunch.

pages.text: She finds a lemon.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb finds a bright yellow lemon under a lemon tree.

pages.text: The lemon is sour! Libby makes a face.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb bites the lemon and makes a funny sour face.

pages.text: Next, she finds some lettuce.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb finds a big green head of lettuce.

pages.text: Libby likes the lettuce.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb happily munches the lettuce.

pages.text: Then Libby sees a ladybug.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb notices a little red ladybug on a leaf.

pages.text: "Can I have some lunch too?" asks the ladybug.
pages.alt: The ladybug looks hopefully at Libby the lamb, asking for lunch.

pages.text: Libby gives her a leaf.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb gives the ladybug a green leaf.

pages.text: They eat lunch on a log.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb and the ladybug eat lunch together on a fallen log.

pages.text: Libby laughs. Lunch is more fun with a friend.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb laughs happily beside the ladybug.

pages.text: Libby and the ladybug lie down to rest.
pages.alt: Libby the lamb and the ladybug lie down on soft grass resting, eyes closed.

books.title: Leon's Lantern
books.coverAlt: Leon the lion cub holds up a glowing lantern at night by a lake, Lucky the white puppy beside him.

pages.text: Leon the lion has a lantern.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub stands holding an unlit lantern, evening sky.

pages.text: It is night. Leon cannot see.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub in the dark night, squinting, can't see.

pages.text: He turns on his lantern.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub switches on his lantern; warm light glows.

pages.text: Now Leon can see the lake.
pages.alt: Leon's lantern lights up a calm lake at night.

pages.text: Where is his pet, Lucky? Leon looks.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub holds his lantern up, looking around worried for his pet.

pages.text: Leon looks by the logs.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub peeks behind a pile of logs with his lantern.

pages.text: Leon looks under a leaf.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub lifts a huge leaf with his lantern, looking under it.

pages.text: Leon hears a noise. Woof!
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub perks his ears up, hearing a noise in the dark.

pages.text: It is Lucky! Lucky licks Leon.
pages.alt: Lucky the white puppy jumps up and licks Leon's face.

pages.text: Leon laughs and hugs Lucky.
pages.alt: Leon the lion cub laughs and hugs Lucky the puppy.

pages.text: They go home by the light of the lantern.
pages.alt: Leon and Lucky walk home along a path lit by the lantern.

pages.text: Leon and Lucky rest by the lantern.
pages.alt: Leon and Lucky rest curled up beside the glowing lantern.

pages.text: Theo thinks it is a fun day.
Theo is thirsty. He sips a big drink.
Thump! Thud! What is it?
It is thunder! Theo hides his head.
Theo feels a bit scared.
Theo's pal Thea comes over.
"Theo, think of a fun thing!" says Thea.
Theo thinks of a thick, warm blanket.
Theo and Thea sit under a thick blanket.
Thea hums a tune. Theo taps his thumb.
Soon, no more thunder.
"Thanks, Thea!" Theo gives a big thumbs up.

books.title: Thor Says Thank You
books.coverAlt: Thor the big brown bear smiles in a sunny meadow, giving a thumbs up, with Fox, Bee and Owl around him.

pages.text: Thor is a big, kind bear.
pages.alt: Thor the big brown bear smiles in a sunny forest meadow.

pages.text: Thor thinks of his pals.
pages.alt: Thor the bear sits thinking, eyes up, smiling.

pages.text: "I want to thank my pals," says Thor.
pages.alt: Thor the bear stands with his paws on his heart, cheerful.

pages.text: Thor picks a thick red flower.
pages.alt: Thor the bear picks a big red flower with a thick stem.

pages.text: He gives it to Fox. "Thank you, Fox!"
pages.alt: Thor the bear gives the red flower to Fox.

pages.text: Thor finds a thimble of honey.
pages.alt: Thor the bear holds a tiny thimble full of golden honey.

pages.text: He gives it to Bee. "Thank you, Bee!"
pages.alt: Thor the bear gives the thimble of honey to Bee.

pages.text: Thor is thirsty. He sips some water.
pages.alt: Thor the bear drinks water from a stream, thirsty.

pages.text: He thinks of one more pal.
pages.alt: Thor the bear thinking, one paw on his chin.

pages.text: It is Owl! Owl helps Thor every day.
pages.alt: Owl on a branch waves a wing at Thor the bear.

pages.text: Thor gives Owl a big thumbs up.
pages.alt: Thor the bear gives Owl a big thumbs up.

pages.text: "Thanks, Thor!" his pals say. Thor is so happy.
pages.alt: Fox, Bee and Owl cheer around Thor the bear, who smiles happily.

books.title: Thelma's Thirsty Plant
books.coverAlt: Thelma holds a watering cup over her little potted plant on a sunny windowsill, the plant blooming a big pink flower.

pages.text: Thelma has a plant.
pages.alt: Thelma stands beside her little potted plant on a windowsill.

pages.text: Thelma's plant is thirsty.
pages.alt: Thelma's little plant droops with thin sad leaves.

pages.text: Its leaves look thin and sad.
pages.alt: Close up of the plant's thin drooping leaves.

pages.text: Thelma thinks.
pages.alt: Thelma thinks with one finger on her chin.

pages.text: "I know! It needs water!" thinks Thelma.
pages.alt: Thelma has a happy idea, pointing up, a cup in her hand.

pages.text: Thelma fills a cup. Thud! It falls.
pages.alt: Thelma's cup of water tips over and falls with a splash.

pages.text: Thelma tries again.
pages.alt: Thelma fills the cup again, determined.

pages.text: Thelma gives her plant a big drink.
pages.alt: Thelma pours water into the plant pot.

pages.text: Thelma waits and thinks.
pages.alt: Thelma waits patiently, sitting beside the pot.

pages.text: Soon, a thick bud pops up.
pages.alt: A thick green bud pops up on the plant.

pages.text: Thelma says thanks to her plant.
pages.alt: Thelma smiles and talks kindly to her plant.

pages.text: It is a big pink flower! Thelma gives it a thumbs up.
pages.alt: A big pink flower blooms; Thelma gives a thumbs up.

pages.text: This is a big bear. That is a little bee.
They are pals. They like to play.
"Let's go there!" says the bear.
There is a pond by the hill.
Then they see the ducks.
"Look at those ducks!" says the bee.
The ducks swim in a line.
"These seeds are for them," says the bee.
They toss the seeds to the ducks.
The ducks quack, "Yum, yum!"
Then the sun sets.
"That was the best day!" say the pals.
Rory the rabbit rides a red rocket.
The rocket roars over the rainbow.
Rory sees a robot on a rock.
The robot gives Rory a ring.
They race around the river.
Rory roars: hooray, hooray!
Reba the robot runs on a road.
Reba rolls past a red rose.
A rabbit races right by.
Reba wraps it in a ribbon.
Rain! They run for the roof.
Reba the robot: ready, ready!
Ruby the rooster rises at dawn.
Ruby crows: rise and shine!
She runs around the red barn.
Ruby finds a wriggly worm.
The rooster pecks rows of corn.
Ruby rests. What a great run!
Remy the raccoon roams the river.
He reaches under a round rock.
Remy grabs a ripe, red grape.
He rows a raft in the rain.
Remy rests in the reeds.
Remy the raccoon: hooray!
Rex the rhino runs really fast.
He roars down the rocky road.
Rex rolls in the rich, green grass.
He reaches for a red apple.
Rex meets a friendly rabbit.
Run, Rex, run! Hooray!
Sunny the seal sits in the sun.
Sunny sees a silly snake.
The snake slides on the soft sand.
They sip soup with a silver spoon.
Sunny sings a silly song.
So sleepy! Sunny says goodnight.
Lily the lion licks a lemon lollipop.
Lily leaps over a little log.
A ladybug lands on a leaf.
Lily laughs: la la la!
They look at a yellow balloon.
Lily loves to play all day.
Kiki the koala bakes a cake.
A kind king comes with a key.
The king flies a colorful kite.
Kiki gives the king a cookie.
A cat and a cow come to play.
What a cool day for Kiki!
Shelly the sheep shines her shoes.
She shows a shiny shell to a fish.
They sail on a big ship. Shhh!
Shelly makes a wish on a star.
She sips a milkshake — so fresh.
Shhh… Shelly is sleeping now.
Charlie the chick chews chewy cherries.
Charlie rides the choo-choo train.
He munches cheese at lunch.
A chipmunk sits on a chair.
They share chocolate chips. Crunch!
Charlie chirps: cheep, cheep, cheep.
Theo the sloth thinks happy thoughts.
Theo counts: one, two, three!
He gives a big thumbs up.
Theo brushes his three teeth.
Then a warm bath — both feet in.
Thank you, moon. Theo says goodnight.
Gus the goat grows a green garden.
A goose gives Gus a gift.
Gus plays a goofy guitar.
They gobble grapes by the gate.
A bug giggles on the grass.
Good game, Gus. Goodnight!
Fifi the fox finds four feathers.
Fifi feeds a funny fish.
They warm five feet by the fire.
A butterfly flies fast — wow!
Fifi has fun with her friends.
Fifi waves: farewell, farewell!

books.title: Bear's Lost Ball
books.coverAlt: Bear holds his red ball beside a friendly bee in a sunny park.

pages.text: Bear has a big red ball.
pages.alt: Bear holds a red ball with a cream stripe beside a river in the park.

pages.text: The ball bounces away!
pages.alt: The red ball bounces away as Bear reaches after it.

pages.text: Bear looks by the bus.
pages.alt: Bear looks beside a parked teal bus, but the ball is not there.

pages.text: Bear looks by the boat.
pages.alt: Bear looks beside a red rowboat on the river bank, but the ball is not there.

pages.text: A bee finds the ball!
pages.alt: A friendly bee finds the red ball in the grass while Bear cheers.

pages.text: Bear bounces the ball.
pages.alt: Bear happily bounces his red ball on the sunny park path.

pages.text: Bear and the bee play ball.
pages.alt: Bear and the friendly bee play with the red ball on the grass.

pages.text: Bear takes his ball to bed.
pages.alt: Bear sleeps in bed with his red ball safely beside him.

books.title: Rabbit and the Rocket
books.coverAlt: Rabbit and a friendly blue robot proudly hold a small toy rocket beside a muddy patch.

pages.text: Rabbit has a toy rocket.
pages.alt: Rabbit holds a small red-and-cream toy rocket beside a muddy patch.

pages.text: The rocket is stuck in mud.
pages.alt: The toy rocket is stuck upright in shallow mud.

pages.text: Rabbit gives it a tug.
pages.alt: Rabbit tugs at the rocket from the dry edge of the mud.

pages.text: A robot comes to help.
pages.alt: A friendly blue robot arrives to help Rabbit.

pages.text: The robot puts a rock by the mud.
pages.alt: The robot places a low, rounded tan rock beside the mud.

pages.text: Rabbit hops onto the rock.
pages.alt: Rabbit stands safely on the low rock beside the rocket.

pages.text: The robot and Rabbit give a big tug.
pages.alt: Rabbit and the robot pull the toy rocket together.

pages.text: Up comes the rocket! Rabbit is so happy.
pages.alt: Rabbit and the robot happily hold the rescued toy rocket on dry ground.

books.title: Seal and the Sock
books.coverAlt: A cream-gray seal happily holds a clean yellow sock with a teal cuff.

pages.text: A seal has a sock.
pages.alt: A cream-gray seal holds a yellow sock with a teal cuff.

pages.text: The sock is full of sand.
pages.alt: The seal peers into the sock, which contains a little sand.

pages.text: The seal gives it a shake.
pages.alt: The seal shakes sand out of the upside-down sock.

pages.text: Sand goes on the seal!
pages.alt: A little sand lands on the surprised seal's head.

pages.text: The seal can dunk the sock in a tub.
pages.alt: The seal dips the yellow sock into a shallow tub of water.

pages.text: The sock is wet and heavy.
pages.alt: The damp sock droops above the tub, dripping water.

pages.text: The seal hangs it in the sun.
pages.alt: The seal clips the sock onto a low line in the warm sun.

pages.text: The sock is dry. The seal can put it on.
pages.alt: The seal proudly wears the dry sock on one front flipper.

books.title: Lion and the Lock
books.coverAlt: A golden lion cub holds a key beside a teal box with a gold lock.

pages.text: A lion has a box with a lock.
pages.alt: A golden lion cub points to the lock on a small teal box.

pages.text: The lock needs a key.
pages.alt: The lion looks at the closed gold lock and its keyhole.

pages.text: The lion peeks into a bag.
pages.alt: The lion peeks into a cream bag beside the locked box.

pages.text: A lemon! No key.
pages.alt: The lion finds a yellow lemon in the bag instead of a key.

pages.text: The lion peeks under a leaf.
pages.alt: The lion lifts a broad green leaf and looks underneath.

pages.text: No key. The lion turns on a lamp.
pages.alt: The lion switches on a small cream lamp with a teal base.

pages.text: A key is by the lamp!
pages.alt: The lion spots a gold key beside the lamp in its warm light.

pages.text: Pop! The lock is open. A tiny teddy is inside!
pages.alt: The lock is open and the lion finds a tiny brown teddy inside the box.

books.title: Sheep and the Ship
books.coverAlt: A fluffy sheep holds a toy ship beside a teal shoe and a garden puddle.

pages.text: A sheep has a toy ship.
pages.alt: A fluffy sheep holds a small red-and-cream toy ship.

pages.text: The ship is in a big puddle.
pages.alt: The toy ship floats in a garden puddle just beyond the sheep's reach.

pages.text: The sheep has no boat.
pages.alt: The sheep looks at the toy ship with empty paws.

pages.text: A shoe can be a boat!
pages.alt: The sheep notices a large teal shoe beside the puddle.

pages.text: The sheep puts the shoe in the puddle.
pages.alt: The sheep pushes the teal shoe onto the puddle like a little boat.

pages.text: The shoe bumps the ship.
pages.alt: The floating shoe gently nudges the toy ship toward the dry edge.

pages.text: The sheep picks up the ship.
pages.alt: The sheep lifts the toy ship out of the puddle.

pages.text: The ship is safe and dry.
pages.alt: The sheep hugs the dry toy ship on a towel beside the shoe.

books.title: Chicken and the Picnic
books.coverAlt: A russet-red hen and a white bunny share a picnic on a red gingham cloth.

pages.text: A chicken has a big picnic.
pages.alt: A russet-red hen stands beside a picnic bag and folded gingham cloth.

pages.text: The chicken puts cheese in a bag.
pages.alt: The hen puts a cheese wedge into the cream picnic bag.

pages.text: A cherry goes in, too.
pages.alt: The hen adds a small cup of prepared cherry halves to the bag.

pages.text: In goes a bit of chocolate.
pages.alt: The hen adds a little piece of chocolate to the picnic bag.

pages.text: The chicken puts the bag on a chair.
pages.alt: The hen sets the full picnic bag on a low teal chair.

pages.text: Oh no! The chair tips.
pages.alt: The low chair tips and the picnic bag slides toward the hen.

pages.text: The chicken grabs the bag!
pages.alt: The hen safely catches the bag before it reaches the ground.

pages.text: The chicken and a pal eat the cheese.
pages.alt: The hen and a white bunny share cheese on the picnic cloth.

books.title: My Thumb Paints a Gift
books.coverAlt: A child proudly holds a card with a blue-and-pink thumbprint butterfly.

pages.text: I think I can make a gift.
pages.alt: A child has an idea for a gift at a craft table.

pages.text: I dip my thumb in blue paint.
pages.alt: The child dips a thumb into blue paint.

pages.text: My thumb makes a dot.
pages.alt: A blue thumbprint appears on a white card.

pages.text: I think it needs a buddy.
pages.alt: The child looks thoughtfully at the single blue thumbprint.

pages.text: I dip my thumb in pink paint.
pages.alt: The child dips a clean thumb into pink paint.

pages.text: My thumb makes a pink dot.
pages.alt: A pink thumbprint appears beside the blue one.

pages.text: I think of a butterfly.
pages.alt: The child adds a body and antennae to make a blue-and-pink butterfly.

pages.text: My thumb made a butterfly! A gift for Mom.
pages.alt: The child proudly gives the butterfly card to Mom.
